title: Pokemon Sylveon ex 041/131 Prismatic Evolutions Ultra Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Pokemon Sylveon ex 041/131 card from the Prismatic Evolutions set is a highly sought-after Ultra Rare collectible in the Pokemon trading card game. Manufactured by The Pokemon Company, this English-language card features the popular Pokemon character Sylveon and is part of the EX specialty line. With a standard card size and made from durable card stock material, this card is suitable for players aged 6 and up. Highly collectible and prized for its rarity, the Sylveon Ex card is a valuable addition to any Pokemon card collection.
